ambient_events: A slot machine somewhere sings a jackpot no one won.
The cashier counts a strap of chips without once looking up.
description: A low room drowned in dying neon, where the carpet was chosen to hide sins and does. Felt tables ring a caged cashier, and every surface tilts a fraction toward the house. The air is climate-controlled to a permanent, luckless 2 a.m.
name: The Neon Vig
